item.title: Kaiser Permanente strike enters 5th day as 31,000 health care workers walk out
item.description: Thousands of Kaiser Permanente nurses and specialty health care professionals are continuing a massive, multi-state strike this Friday, marking nearly a week of picket lines as contract negotiations remain stalled. The strike, which began Monday morning, involves approximately 31,000 members of the United Nurses Associations of California/Union of Health Care Professionals (UNAC/UHCP).
